modules.title: Data Fundamentals
modules.description: Introduction to data science, types of data, and data visualization.

modules.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
modules.description: This module introduces students to the process of exploratory data analysis, including data cleaning, visualization, and summary statistics. Students will learn how to use various tools and techniques to understand the distribution of variables, identify patterns, and make informed decisions. By the end of this module, students will be able to apply exploratory data analysis techniques to real-world datasets.

modules.title: Linear Regression
modules.description: This module covers the basics of linear regression, including data preparation, model selection, and interpretation. Students will learn how to implement linear regression using popular machine learning libraries and understand its limitations. By the end of this module, students should be able to apply linear regression to real-world problems.

modules.title: Machine Learning Basics
modules.description: This module covers the fundamentals of machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, and model evaluation.

modules.title: Statistical Inference
modules.description: This module covers the principles and techniques of statistical inference, including hypothesis testing and confidence intervals.

modules.title: Time Series Analysis
modules.description: This module covers the analysis of time series data, including trend identification, seasonality detection, and forecasting. It also introduces techniques for handling missing values and outliers in time series data.

modules.title: Deep Learning
modules.description: This module covers the fundamentals of deep learning, including neural networks and convolutional neural networks. It also explores advanced topics such as recurrent neural networks and transfer learning.

modules.title: Text Analysis
modules.description: This module focuses on extracting insights from unstructured text data, including natural language processing and machine learning techniques.

modules.title: Predictive Modeling
modules.description: This module focuses on advanced techniques for building predictive models, including ensemble methods and model selection. Students will learn how to evaluate and compare different models using metrics such as accuracy and cross-validation. They will also explore the use of regularization techniques to prevent overfitting.
